versions.content: API Function Header File Description Csm _ Key - Element Get Csm.h Retrieves the key element bytes from a specific key element of the key identified by the key Id and stores the key element in the memory location pointed by the key pointer. Csm _ Key - Element Set Csm.h Sets the given key element bytes to the key ide ntified by key Id. Csm _ Key Set - Valid Csm.h Sets the key state of the key identified by key Id to valid.
